latestVersion.changelog:
Viral Short-Form Video Factory v1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Instantly generates 30 short-form videos (TikTok, Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts) based on viral trend analysis.
- Automates idea research, script writing, AI voiceover, video production, and export for each platform.
- Includes niche-specific viral analysis, top hooks, optimal posting times, and content calendar.
- Supports any niche and language, with customizable brand tone and posting goals.
- Integrates with Apify (platform scraping), InVideo AI (video production), and Claude AI (scripting/copywriting).
- Delivers platform-ready videos, scripts, captions, hashtags, and a 30-day posting schedule.
